spans.s: śeka (EI 11), same as Sanskrit śikya, a loop or swing made of rope and suspended from the ends of a pole placed on one's shoulder for carrying loads, or the load itself. Cf. saṃkācitaka.
Sekyakāra (EI 12; BL), a brazier; secondarily, an engraver; cf. Bengali seṅkrā, a goldsmith.
śekk-āyam (SITI), Tamil-Sanskrit; tax on oil-presses; also called śekk-ir̤ai and śekku-kkaḍamai (SII 12).
śekku-man̤r̤āḍi (SITI), Tamil; a tax or cess; probably related to śekku.
